news.title: University of Minnesota launches Interdisciplinary Computing major
news.summary_en: The University of Minnesota Twin Cities is launching Interdisciplinary Computing, an undergraduate major that combines a foundation in computer science with in-depth study in another discipline.

news.title: A step toward organs waiting for patients, not patients waiting for organs
news.summary_en: University of Minnesota Twin Cities researchers have restored function in cryogenically preserved pig kidneys comparable in size to human kidneys, overcoming a major barrier to long-term organ banking.
